question.text: Which of the following compounds will not undergo Friedel Crafts reaction with benzene?

solution.text: Formation of carbocation is not possible in case of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CH</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>CHCl</mi></math>,​because partial double bond character is present in carbon and chlorine bond due to resonance between lone pair of chlorine atom and double bond.
